case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment's caption.

number_of_accused.reason: Headnote states 'Of 6 accused'; the body notes seven originally, with one juvenile separated.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are referred to by male pronouns ('he') throughout; male is reasonably supported.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for any accused in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not stated; judgment only says accused belong to the same community.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of accused is not mentioned.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased is referred to as male ('his hand', 'he'); male is supported.

victim_age.reason: No age of the deceased appears in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: due to old enmity, attacked with sharp weapon with intention to kill
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment shows the accused had old enmity with the deceased, so 'Stranger' is contradicted.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under Section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Conviction under s.302 read with ss.148 and 149 IPC matches the judgment.

weapon.reason: Sword, farsa, axe and lathis are all identified as weapons used.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, circumstantial, medical and recovery evidence are all relied on.

confession.correct_value: Section 27 disclosure statements recorded (Exhibits P18 to P21); not described as confessions
confession.quote: Section 27 Statement under Exhibits P18 to P21
confession.reason: Section 27 statements exist; 'None' omits them, though they are not called confessions.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not discuss aggravating circumstances; 'None noted' is acceptable.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not discuss mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under s.302 r/w 148, 149 and imposed life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.quote: The Division Bench having confirmed the conviction and sentence imposed on the appellants
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and sentence; 'Not applicable' contradicts this.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, so conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 IPC was held established.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term in years is stated; null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts only, omitting the courts' outcomes: the prosecution case of a 27 June 1997 attack on the Sarpanch by armed accused, medical and post-mortem records, arrest, charge and trial.
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court confirmed the conviction and sentence, finding the prosecution's case supported by eyewitness accounts, medical evidence, and other material evidence.
neutral_facts.reason: Neutral facts reveal the court outcome and reasoning, which the rule prohibits. Also the 'Sarpanch' detail is not wrong but the outcome statements must be removed.

offence_severity.reason: Life imprisonment under s.302 is the sentence stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Offence was completed; the deceased died from the attack.

physical_harm.reason: Eight injuries with four grievous, and P.W.3's injuries noted in medical records, match the judgment.

number_of_offences.reason: Charged offences and the conviction under s.302 r/w 148, 149 are accurately listed.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or financial loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.quote: making a pronouncement that he cannot escape that day
premeditation_planning.reason: The pronouncement is part of the prosecution's narrative; the court made no premeditation finding.

motive.reason: Column 5 of the Crime Details Form records motive as old enmity.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness evidence of P.W.3 and P.W.6, corroborated by others, was accepted.

witness_credibility.reason: Judgment calls P.W.3's evidence cogent and supported by P.W.6, P.Ws.7 and 11.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is discussed.

trial_duration.quote: common judgment and order dated 7th September, 2006 of the Division Bench of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: 07.09.2006 is the High Court judgment date; the trial court judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellants and State match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.reason: FIR registration, charge sheet and completed trial are all reflected in the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.quote: even though the delay was quite apparent by virtue of Exhibit 08
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment acknowledges an apparent delay in forwarding the Express Report, so 'None noted' is contradicted.

correct_value.trial_court: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Pala Singh, Main Patel and Bhajan Singh are cited as relied upon.
